g.text: 1. D1 / CM1: staggered, with shared nets at opposite ends.
2. D2 / CM2: staggered, with shared nets at opposite ends.
3. D3 / CM3: staggered, with shared nets at opposite ends.
4. D4 / CM4: staggered, with shared nets at opposite ends.
All four diode/capacitor pairs form compact parallel branches.
